ace-batched.implementation: ACE-inspired deterministic batch adaptation over one shared H0 Feedback pass
ace-batched.variant: four sequential playbook-only delta updates over fixed Feedback shards
adaptations: The H0 Generator trajectories are collected once and reused across the four update steps.
Each step combines reflection and curation into one read-only updater session.
Only profiles/cowork.md is materialized as persistent mutable state.

ace.variant: serial offline loop with curator_frequency=1 and three reflection rounds
adaptations: The MSA artifact solver and native Cowork verifier replace the text generator and task evaluator.
Reflector and Curator run as isolated read-only Codex sessions.
The controller applies ADD operations and bullet counters to profiles/cowork.md.

evo-bench.variant: Cowork/Codex adaptation of the executable-harness evolution loop
adaptations: One Codex session submits one candidate; it receives the latest validation pass plus cumulative structured history, and evaluation is synchronous.
Feedback is detailed, Selection is aggregate-only, and Final remains sealed.
The current revision continues after regressions while the best Selection checkpoint is frozen.
